defects.summary: contract-check C4 required each test ID as an exact quoted literal; the UI agent's tests carry the ID as the first word of the test name, so 5 UI-owned IDs read as missing
defects.repair: C4 now accepts a string literal that starts with the ID followed by a space or quote (still requires a named test per ID)
defects.couldHaveBeenDetectedEarlier: yes: both agents were given different wording for the ID convention

defects.summary: After Start investigation the UI saved automatically and showed 'Saved (version 1)'; the registry says INV-004 leaves the save state Unsaved and writes nothing
defects.rootCause: App.fs SubmitStart appended startSave; the UI agent's own tests did not assert the post-start save state, and the binding check is static
defects.couldHaveBeenDetectedEarlier: yes: a unit test spec per registry 'transition' field would have caught it in the UI agent's loop
